title: 第 13章 原来如此第 14章 呜呼哀哉
slug: 杀妖涨修为道爷我成了
lines: 沈回瘫在地上，胸口那个破开的窟窿凉飕飕的，倒也不怎么疼了。
大概是疼过了头，疼到连疼都觉不出来了。
他睁着眼，望着头顶黑漆漆的房梁，脑子里一堆乱七八糟的念头左冲右突。
就像是一群没头的苍蝇。
嗡嗡嗡，嗡嗡嗡，抓又抓不住，赶又赶不走，实在恼人的很。
灶房顶上有根梁，梁上有根椽，椽上有片瓦，瓦上有颗星星……不对，瓦是盖着的，看不见星星。
那星星应该是他头晕才冒出来的。
那瓦片是青灰色的还是灰青色的？
——白天好像瞧见过，是青灰色的。
青灰色好看还是灰青色好看？
——好像都差不多。
他心想自己的脑子应该是在刚才的争斗中受了重创，此刻大概已经成一锅浆糊了。
还是煮熟的浆糊！
想低头看一眼自己胸口被破开的窟窿，但却是连一丝抬头的力气都欠奉。
罢了罢了。
就这样躺着等死吧……
只可惜自己刚来不久，还没有好好体验一下这方世界。
只可惜那心灯之法，刚学会就要带着一起躺棺材。
只可惜……
沈回正天马行空地想着，忽然“砰”的一声巨响。
伙房的门被人一脚踹开了！
夜风呼呼地灌进来，带着一股子腥臭之气。
沈回躺在地上动不了，只能斜着眼睛朝门口瞄去。
门口站着几个黑影，沈回借着从门口照进来的微弱天光，隐约能看出个大概。
浑身红毛，脑袋光秃秃的，一张脸皱得跟风干的橘子皮似的，偏偏还长着一嘴獠牙，龇在外面，好像要寻个什么东西拱上一拱。
夜叉。
沈回脑子里冒出这两个字。
不是那种壁画上威武狰狞的护法夜叉，而是那种话本里专吃人心的野夜叉。
红毛秃瓢，面目可憎，嘴角还挂着涎水，嘀嗒嘀嗒往下淌。
为首那只夜叉大步跨进来，一眼便瞧见了躺在地上的沈回。
它咧嘴一笑，露出一口参差不齐的黄牙，随即抬起手，五指虚空一抓。
沈回立刻觉得身子一轻，整个人便腾空飞起，直直落进了那只夜叉的掌中。
那手掌粗糙干裂，指甲又黑又长，掐在他脖子上，硌得生疼。
沈回耷拉着脑袋，连眼皮都抬不起来，只能从眼缝里模模糊糊看见那夜叉的另一只手伸过来。
它爪子里捏着一条红彤彤的大虫子，又肥又粗，还在扭动。
content_en:
Shen Hui collapsed on the ground. The hole in his chest was cold, but it didn't hurt much anymore.
The pain was probably too much, so painful that I couldn't even feel the pain.
He opened his eyes and looked at the dark beams above his head, with a bunch of messy thoughts in his mind.
Like a swarm of headless flies.
Buzzing, buzzing, buzzing, catching but unable to catch, rushing but unable to drive away, it is really annoying.
There is a beam on the roof of the kitchen, a rafter on the beam, a tile on the rafter, and a star on the tile... No, the tile is covered, so you can't see the star.
The stars probably appeared because he was dizzy.
Are the tiles blue-gray or gray-green?
——I think I've seen it during the day, it's blue-grey.
Does blue-grey look better or gray-blue looks better?
——They seem to be pretty much the same.
He thought that his brain must have been severely damaged in the fight just now, and it was probably turned into a pot of mush at this moment.
Still cooked paste!
He wanted to look down at the hole in his chest, but he didn't even have the strength to raise his head.
That’s all.
Just lie there and wait to die...
It's a pity that I have just arrived and haven't fully experienced this world yet.
It's a pity that the method of the heart lamp has to be laid in the coffin with him as soon as he learns it.
It's a pity...
Shen Hui was thinking wildly when suddenly there was a loud "bang" sound.
The kitchen door was kicked open!
The night wind blew in, bringing with it a fishy smell.
Shen Hui lay on the ground unable to move, and could only squint towards the door.
There were several dark figures standing at the door, and Shen Hui could vaguely make out the outline through the faint light coming in from the door.
He had red hair all over his body, a bald head, and a face as wrinkled as a dried orange peel. It happened to have a pair of fangs that were bared outward, as if he was looking for something to dig into.
Yaksha.
These two words came to Shen Hui's mind.
Not the mighty and ferocious protector Yaksha in the murals, but the kind of wild Yaksha in the storybook who only eats people's hearts.
He was a bald man with red hair and a hideous face. There was saliva hanging from the corners of his mouth, dripping down.
The leading Yaksha strode in and immediately saw Shen Hui lying on the ground.
It grinned, revealing a set of jagged yellow teeth, then raised its hand and grasped the air with its five fingers.
Shen Hui immediately felt his body light up and flew up into the air, falling straight into the palm of the Yaksha.
The palms were rough and cracked, and the nails were black and long. They pinched his neck, causing pain.
Shen Hui drooped his head and couldn't even raise his eyelids. He could only vaguely see Yasha's other hand reaching out through the cracks in his eyes.
It held a big red bug in its claws, fat and thick, and it was still twisting.
